tools.name: getTodos
tools.description: The todos of the caller's workspace. Lists todos: one page of the items under an optional filter document, sort, limit and offset; answers {limit, offset, total, items}.

TodosFilter.description: A filter document (D12) of Todos: at most 8 levels and 200 nodes.

filter.description: An inline filter document; registered as a stored filter on subscribe (D13).

sort.description: Comma-separated fields, "-" for descending, of: id, title, priority, done, dueAt, createdAt, updatedAt.

next.description: The cursor of the next page (cursor mode, D38); absent at the end.

tools.name: getTodosItem
tools.description: The todos of the caller's workspace. Reads one item of todos by its id.

tools.name: getTodosDistinct
tools.description: The todos of the caller's workspace. Counts the distinct values of one field of todos under an optional filter; answers [{value, count}].

TodosFilter.description: A filter document (D12) of Todos: at most 8 levels and 200 nodes.

tools.name: getSummary
tools.description: How many todos of the workspace are open and done, and how many attachments they have. Reads summary.

tools.name: getSummaryPresence
tools.description: How many todos of the workspace are open and done, and how many attachments they have. Lists who is present on the record of summary named by key.

tools.name: createTodo
tools.description: Creates a todo in the caller's workspace. Changes data: POST /todos.

tools.name: updateTodo
tools.description: Changes the fields of a todo that the body carries; clearDueAt removes the due time. Changes data: PATCH /todos/{id}.

tools.name: deleteTodo
tools.description: Deletes a todo. Changes data: DELETE /todos/{id}. Answers nothing.

tools.name: createKey
tools.description: Creates an API key of the caller, for the CLI and the Go client; the answer shows the key once. Changes data: POST /keys.

tools.name: uploadAttachment
tools.description: Attaches a file to a todo. Uploads a file: POST /todos/{id}/attachments, content of type text/plain, image/png, application/pdf, at most 1048576 bytes.

content.description: The file: its text as it is, or its bytes in base64 with contentEncoding base64; at most 1048576 bytes.

contentEncoding.description: How content is written; required, since a file of a type that is not text/* travels in base64.
